title: Revisiting LLM Value Probing Strategies: Are They Robust and Expressive?
findings: The paper did not report findings specific to religion, but the general findings on value probing apply. These include that LLM value representations are sensitive to input formatting (prompt style) and selection bias (option order/labels), with the sequence perplexity method being the most robust against these perturbations. Probed values, including those related to religion, only weakly correlate with the model's action preferences in related scenarios, suggesting they provide limited insight into the model's actual behavior.
references: Asif Agha. 2006. Language and social relations, volume 24. Cambridge University Press.
